title: 第4章  撞坏了脑袋？
slug: 凡人从拔刀三十万次开始
content_zh:
“风起武院！”
陈时安一怔，心中没来由地生出了艳羡。
这股情绪，来自原主的记忆。
风起武院，由风起城寨官方创办，其目的，为城寨选拔出在武道方面有天赋的好苗子，为风起城寨培养武道人才。
一旦被武院选中，便等于是鲤鱼跳入了龙门，将来至少也能在城寨中捞到一官半职，衣食无忧。
原主也参加过风起城寨的考核，只可惜，考核共六关，他连第一关都没过，就被刷了下来。
方明听到风起武院四字，仿佛受到了莫大的鼓舞，腰杆子明显硬挺了许多，清了清嗓子，“陈时安，你不用去城衙告状了。
你和如玉的这桩婚事，就此作罢，我们方家要悔婚。
依照城寨的规矩，我们方家赔你十二两银子。”
听到父亲的这番话，方如玉的脸上现出得意与嘲讽的表情，并将目光投向了陈时安。
只是，令她意外的是，陈时安并没有如她意料中的那样气急败坏，他的表情没有半分的变化，眼神更是澄澈如水。
似乎，方家的退婚与他没有任何关系一般。
在这一刻，方如玉猛然察觉到，陈时安似乎变了。
若是放在以往，陈时安估摸早已羞愤难当，即便不会又哭又闹，撒泼打滚总是免不了的。
此时的陈时安让方如玉感到陌生，心中同时升起一股没来由的挫败感。
难道，我的退婚对他没有半分的触动，甚至是一种解脱？
瞎子！蠢货！一百个你加在一起也配不上我！
装的！陈时安此际的镇定肯定是装的！
方如玉的挫败感很快便转化为愤怒，她皱起了眉头，眼神发冷。
“方掌柜要退婚，早些说嘛，害我白跑这么多趟。

“没问题，我同意！”
“方掌柜赶紧将聘礼双倍还我，这事就到此为止。”
陈时安很是爽快地答应，脸上挂着笑容。
此行如此顺利，出乎他的预料。
说话之时，他顺手将桌上的茶包收进了衣袖。
这是他用身上仅剩的几个铜板买的，既然要退婚，拜访礼自然也得收回来。
方明将陈时安的动作看在眼里，脸皮忍不住抽了抽，冷声道：“你先等一下，我去给你取银子！”
说完，他拂袖走出了房间。
“寒酸！小家子气！”
方如玉冷冷出声。
陈时安却是充耳不闻，当做没听见，一双眼睛在屋内四处查看，就是不去看方如玉。
如此反应，使得方如玉心中的怒火更盛几分。
放在以往，有如此好的独处机会，陈时安必定会化身为舔狗，一双眼睛恨不得粘在方如玉的身上。
“陈时安，你就不要装了，心里有什么不满，就说出来吧。”方如玉微抬着下巴，一副高傲模样。
陈时安微微一笑：“方小姐，咱俩的确不般配，解除婚约是最好的选择，我举双手赞同。”
“撒谎！我能感受到你心中的愤怒。”方如玉高声回应，满脸嘲讽与不屑。
这小仙女也真是够了，非得我生气，才能满足她的虚荣？
陈时安能猜到方如玉的心思，于是长叹一口气，“好吧，方小姐，如你所愿，我现在很生气，气得火冒三丈。
此刻的镇定，是我竭力伪装出来的。
故而，你最好不要继续在我的伤口上撒盐。不然，孤男寡女同处一室，我可不敢保证，我会做出什么天理难容的事情来。”

说完，他还嘿嘿发笑，一双眼睛快速地在方如玉的身上瞟来瞟去，尤其重点关注她初具规模的胸脯。
闻言，方如玉登时变了脸色，果然不敢再说话，还拉开了距离，远远地盯着陈时安，眼神中既是厌恶还有慌张。
陈时安乐得清净，嘴角微翘，开始闭目养神。
很快，急匆匆的脚步声在门外响起，方明回来了，一手拿着银子，一手捏着一张写满了墨字的黄纸。
“把字签了，我把银子给你，我们两家的婚约便算正式解除，从此再无干系。”方明将黄纸递到陈时安的面前。
陈时安瞟了一眼纸上的内容，立马提笔，快速写下了自己的名字。
突然，方明的脸色变了，方如玉的双目之中也现出了惊讶之色。
只见，纸上的“陈时安”三字，铁画银钩，力透纸背，竟是隐隐有了几分大家风范。
前一世在军营之中，陈时安对书法也有一番研究，空了的时候，就会练上几笔，在书法方面，算是小有心得。
在方家父女的印象中，陈时安不学无术，嗜赌如命，何时能写出这么一手好字？
不过，他们很快释然。
很多的人字很丑，甚至大字不识几个，但自己的名字却是写的非常的漂亮。
他们认为，陈时安就是这一类人，在自己名字的书写上，下过一番功夫。
“方掌柜，字已签好，咱们两家的婚约就此解除。”
陈时安自然不知道方家父女的心思，他搁下笔，一把将银子从方明的手中抓了过来，直接转身，大踏步地向着门外走去，没有半分的拖泥带水。
甚至，从始至终，他都不再看方如玉一眼。
看着陈时安快步走出房间，转过拐角，再消失不见，方如玉的眼神复杂起来，没来由的，她的心中升起一股怅然若失的感觉，仿佛错过了什么。
“如玉，早点将婚约解除了也好，等你进入风起武院，身边都是城寨之中的年轻俊彦，随便找一个，都比陈时安要强百倍千倍。”
方明缓步走到女儿的身边，笑容满面。
闻言，方如玉的心情又开朗起来，一脸骄傲地说道：“父亲说的对，能进入风起武院的人，百不足一，女儿能被武院录取，便是人中之凤，非人中之龙，配不上女儿！”

………………
陈时安离开了方家之后，径直去到了之前买茶叶的铺子，一番软磨硬泡，把茶包退了回去，换回三枚铜钱。
此时虽然有了十二两银子，但马上就要有九两的开销。
在没有成为入品武者以前，生存会是一个大难题。茶可以以后再喝，现在一个铜板也不能浪费。
回到陈家的时候，已经是黄昏时候，厨房的黑瓦片上正冒着青烟，苏晴柔正在张罗晚饭。
陈时安拎着两斤猪肉，径直走入厨房，“嫂子，今晚我们加餐。”
把肉放到砧板上，他直接转身，准备离开。
“小叔，肉是哪里来的？”苏晴柔先是一愣，随之急急出声。
自从嫁入陈家，她只见过陈时安往外捎东西，从没有见他给家里添过什么。
今天竟是破天荒地往家里带了肉，苏晴柔在惊讶的同时，又有些害怕，生怕这些肉来路不正。
“当然是买的啊。”陈时安咧嘴一笑。
苏晴柔面色紧张地跟了一句，“小叔，可不兴偷人东西，若是被发现，是要被赶出城寨的。”
陈时安连连摇头，“嫂子，你就放心吧，这是我在肉铺买的。
正是晚间收摊的时候，肉虽然不太新鲜，但价格便宜。”
苏晴柔眨了眨眼睛，“小叔，你今天赢钱了？”
陈时安不想多解释，便嗯了一声。
苏晴柔接着说道：“小叔，咱家现在正缺银子，不应当浪费…………。”
陈时安摆了摆手，“肉已经买了，赶紧下锅做饭吧，甜甜现在都瘦成什么样了，她正是长身体的时候，不能太亏着她。”
说完，他快步离开了厨房，回去继续修炼拔刀术。
苏晴柔看着陈时安的背影，眼神复杂起来。

认识陈时安这么久，还是第一次见到他关心别人。
半晌之后，她喃喃出声：“莫不是今天撞树上，撞坏脑袋了？”
这个时候，陈甜甜进到了厨房，看到砧板上的肉，当即喜声道：“母亲，你去买肉了么？”
自从父亲受伤卧病，家里的银钱都节省下来就医买药，半年以来，陈甜甜就几乎见不到荤腥。
“是你小叔买回来的。”苏晴柔面带愧色地抚摸着女儿的脑袋。
陈甜甜当即变了脸色，“他买回来的？母亲，咱们可得防着些，小心他是黄鼠狼给鸡拜年，没安好心。”
苏晴柔摇了摇头，“甜甜，可不兴这么说你小叔，你没有发现么，他今天和以往明显有些不一样。”
陈甜甜抬眼看向了陈时安房屋的方向，轻哼道：“他是什么性子，母亲比我更清楚。我敢打赌，等到晚间吃饭的时候，他的狐狸尾巴就会露出来。”
苏晴柔没有再反驳，兴许，女儿说的是对的。
……………
当石碑上的拔刀次数来到四百次的时候，陈甜甜隔着窗户喊吃饭。
陈时安又饿又累，连忙收了横刀，快步往正屋去了。
饭菜很简单，如果不是他买了两斤肉回来，桌上可能就只有一盘腌萝卜和一个老南瓜汤。
米饭煮得很稀，几乎成了粥。
不是苏晴柔的厨艺不好，而是为了节省米粮。
陈时安已经饿得不行，一上桌，几个扒拉就将一碗饭给干完，延续着军营里的作风。
只是，当他去盛饭的时候，竟是看到，锅里干干净净，半颗饭星子都没留下。
“小叔，实在对不起，饭煮少了，要不多吃些菜吧。”苏晴柔面现歉意之色，连忙将装着小炒肉的盘子放到了陈时安的面前。
同时，她也有几分疑惑，一直以来，陈时安就没有添饭的习惯，有时候一碗饭都吃不完。
这也是为何，原主一个大老爷们，竟然拽不动看起来娇滴滴的苏晴柔。

“没事，我多喝点汤就是。”陈时安微微一笑，给自己盛上满满的一碗南瓜汤。
“成天游手好闲，吃多了也是浪费。”陈甜甜轻哼一声。
苏晴柔登时变了脸色，急忙说道：“小叔，你可千万不要生气，甜甜还小，不会说话。”
说完，她满脸怒色地盯着陈甜甜，“丫头，赶紧给小叔道歉！”
看到母亲真的动怒，陈甜甜意识到自己的话有些重了，稍作犹豫，便准备开口道歉。
这时，陈时安却是轻声一笑，“小叔的身体已经定型，吃得再多都不会长个。
你就不同了，你正长身体呢，多吃点肉，快长高些。”
一边说话，他一边将小炒肉端到了陈甜甜的面前。
再端起南瓜汤，咕咚咕咚地喝了个干净。
随之，他抹了一下嘴，站起身来，“嫂子，我吃饱了，你们慢慢吃。”
言罢，他快步走出正屋，回到了自己的房间，继续进行拔刀大业。
正屋内，苏清柔和陈甜甜四目相对，表情复杂。
今日，陈甜甜多次对陈时安冷嘲热讽。
若是依照陈时安以往的性子，早就开口反击，弄不好还会动手。
但就在刚刚，面对陈甜甜的嘲讽，陈时安居然还满脸的笑容，没有半分的怒意。
“母亲，小叔这是怎么了，他真的转性了？”
陈甜甜看着身前的小炒肉，满眼的意外和疑惑，继而，她的脸上露出极其肯定的表情，“我们千万不要被他的伎俩给迷惑，他肯定没安什么好心思。
他有银钱买肉，却不还我压岁钱，还是无耻无赖。
我猜想，他要赶我们走，硬的行不通，就打算施展阴谋诡计。
是的！一定是这样！

母亲，我们千万不要轻信他，不能上了他的当。”
苏晴柔看着小脸黄瘦的女儿，既是心疼又是欣慰。
在荒墟求生，多一分谨慎、多一个心眼，就能多一条活路。
“甜甜，不管陈时安是真心改过，还是在和我们演戏，你以后说话可得谨慎一些，莫要真把他给惹恼了。
若是他真的把我们赶出了陈家，我们失去城寨居民的身份，我们娘俩马上就会没有活路。”苏清柔低声提醒着。
陈甜甜把小眉头皱到一起，“他凭什么赶我们出陈家？他是父亲捡回来的，本不是我们陈家的人。要赶，也是我们赶他才对！”
苏清柔大惊失色，连忙捂住女儿的嘴巴，“丫头，这样的话你可不许再说。若是让别人听到，我们一家子都得被赶出城寨。
家里没有男丁，就不能在城寨里挂上户籍。没有你小叔，我们陈家就得被销户。”
陈甜甜意识到问题的严重性，连忙说道：“母亲，你放心，这样的话，我以后绝对不会在外面说。”
苏晴柔表情严肃，“不光是不能在外面说，也一定不能让陈时安知道！”
陈甜甜嗯了一声，重重地点头。
content_en:
"The wind rises in the martial arts academy!"
Chen Shi'an was startled, feeling envious for no reason in his heart.
This emotion comes from the memory of the original owner.
Fengqi Martial Arts Academy was officially founded by Fengqi City Walled City. Its purpose is to select talented young people in martial arts for the city and cultivate martial arts talents for Fengqi City Walled City.
Once you are selected by the martial arts academy, it is like a carp jumping into the dragon gate. In the future, you can at least get an official position in the walled city and have no worries about food and clothing.
The original owner also took part in the Fengqi City Walled Assessment. Unfortunately, there were six levels in the assessment, and he didn't even pass the first level and was kicked off.
When Fang Ming heard the words "Feng Qi Wu Yuan", he seemed to be greatly encouraged. His waist became obviously much stiffer and he cleared his throat, "Chen Shi'an, you don't have to go to the city government to complain.
This marriage between you and Ruyu is over, and our Fang family will regret it.
According to the rules of the city, our Fang family will pay you twelve taels of silver. "
Hearing his father's words, Fang Ruyu's face showed a proud and mocking expression, and she turned her gaze to Chen Shi'an.
However, to her surprise, Chen Shi'an was not as angry as she expected. His expression did not change at all, and his eyes were as clear as water.
It seemed that the Fang family's breakup of engagement had nothing to do with him.
At this moment, Fang Ruyu suddenly realized that Chen Shi'an seemed to have changed.
If it were in the past, Chen Shi'an would have been so embarrassed and angry that even if he didn't cry and make trouble, he would always be unavoidable.
At this time, Chen Shi'an felt strange to Fang Ruyu, and an unreasonable sense of frustration arose in her heart.
Could it be that my breaking off the engagement did not touch him in the slightest, or was it even a relief?
blind! idiot! A hundred of you combined are not worthy of me!
Pretending! Chen Shi'an's composure at this moment must be fake!
Fang Ruyu's frustration quickly turned into anger. She frowned and her eyes were cold.
"Shopkeeper Fang wants to break off the engagement. If you had told me earlier, I would have made all these trips in vain.
"No problem, I agree! "
"Shopkeeper Fang quickly returned the dowry gift to me, and that's the end of it. "
Chen Shi'an agreed readily, with a smile on his face.
The trip went so smoothly, beyond his expectation.
As he spoke, he put the tea bag on the table into his sleeve.
He bought this with the few copper coins he had left. Since he wanted to break off the engagement, he naturally had to take back the visiting gift.
Fang Ming saw Chen Shi'an's actions, and couldn't help but twitching his face, and said in a cold voice: "Wait a moment, I'll get the money for you! "
After saying that, he rolled his sleeves and walked out of the room.
"Shabby! Xiaojiaziqi! "
Fang Ruyu said coldly.
Chen Shi'an turned a deaf ear and pretended not to hear. He looked around the room with his eyes, but did not look at Fang Ruyu.
Such a reaction made Fang Ruyu's anger even more intense.
In the past, given such a good opportunity to be alone, Chen Shi'an would definitely turn into a licking dog, with his eyes eager to stick to Fang Ruyu's body.
"Chen Shi'an, stop pretending. If you have any dissatisfaction in your heart, just say it. "Fang Ruyu raised her chin slightly, looking arrogant.
Chen Shi'an smiled slightly: "Miss Fang, we are indeed not a good match. Breaking off the engagement is the best choice. I agree with both hands. "
"Lie! I can feel the anger in your heart. "Fang Ruyu responded loudly, with ridicule and disdain on his face.
This little fairy is really enough. Do I have to be angry to satisfy her vanity?
Chen Shi'an could guess Fang Ruyu's thoughts, so he sighed and said, "Okay, Miss Fang, as you wish, I am very angry now, furious.
The calmness I felt at this moment was something I tried my best to fake.
Therefore, you'd better not continue to rub salt in my wounds. Otherwise, if a man and a woman are alone in the same room, I can't guarantee that I will do something unjust. "
After saying that, he still laughed, and his eyes quickly glanced back and forth on Fang Ruyu's body, especially the heavy ones.Pay attention to her budding breasts.
Hearing this, Fang Ruyu's expression immediately changed. As expected, she did not dare to speak anymore. She even distanced herself and stared at Chen Shi'an from a distance, with disgust and panic in her eyes.
Chen Shi An Le felt calm, the corners of his mouth curled up slightly, and he began to close his eyes to rest.
Soon, hurried footsteps sounded outside the door, and Fang Ming came back, holding silver in one hand and a piece of yellow paper filled with ink characters in the other.
"Sign it and I'll give you the money. Our engagement will be officially terminated and we will have nothing to do with each other from now on." Fang Ming handed the yellow paper to Chen Shi'an.
Chen Shi'an glanced at the content on the paper, immediately picked up his pen, and quickly wrote his name.
Suddenly, Fang Ming's expression changed, and Fang Ruyu's eyes also showed surprise.
I saw that the three characters "Chen Shi'an" on the paper, with iron painted silver hooks, penetrated through the back of the paper, and it actually seemed to have a bit of a master's style.
In his previous life in the military camp, Chen Shi'an also studied calligraphy. When he was free, he would practice a few strokes, and he had some experience in calligraphy.
In the impression of the Fang family's father and daughter, Chen Shi'an was uneducated and addicted to gambling. When could he write such good calligraphy?
However, they were quickly relieved.
Many of the Chinese characters are ugly, and I can't even read a few Chinese characters, but my name is very beautifully written.
They believe that Chen Shi'an is this type of person and has put a lot of effort into writing his name.
"Shopkeeper Fang, the words have been signed and the engagement between our two families has been terminated."
Chen Shi'an naturally didn't know what the Fang family's father and daughter were thinking. He put down his pen, grabbed the money from Fang Ming's hand, turned around, and strode out the door without any hesitation.
Even, from beginning to end, he never looked at Fang Ruyu again.
Watching Chen Shi'an walk out of the room quickly, turn around the corner, and disappear again, Fang Ruyu's eyes became complicated. For no reason, she felt a sense of loss in her heart, as if she had missed something.
"Ruyu, it's better to break off the engagement as soon as possible. When you enter Fengqi Martial Academy, you will be surrounded by young talents in the city. Any one of you can be a hundred times stronger than Chen Shi'an."
Fang Ming walked slowly to his daughter's side with a smile on his face.
Hearing this, Fang Ruyu's mood became cheerful again, and she said with a proud face: "Father is right, less than one person in a hundred can enter Fengqi Martial Arts Academy. If a daughter is admitted to the Martial Arts Academy, she is a phoenix among men, not a dragon among men, and is not worthy of her daughter!"
………………
After Chen Shi'an left the Fang family, he went straight to the shop where he bought tea. After a while, he returned the tea bag and exchanged it for three copper coins.
Although I have twelve taels of silver at this time, I will soon have nine taels of expenses.
Before becoming a top-grade warrior, survival would be a big problem. You can drink tea later, but not a single copper is wasted now.
When I returned to Chen's house, it was already dusk, smoke was rising from the black tiles in the kitchen, and Su Qingrou was preparing dinner.
Chen Shi'an carried two kilograms of pork and walked straight into the kitchen, "Sister-in-law, let's have extra food tonight."
Putting the meat on the cutting board, he turned around and prepared to leave.
"Uncle, where does the meat come from?" Su Qingrou was stunned for a moment, then spoke hurriedly.
Since marrying into the Chen family, she has only seen Chen Shi'an carrying things out, but she has never seen him add anything to the family.
Today, for the first time, she brought meat to her home. While Su Qingrou was surprised, she was also a little scared, fearing that the meat had come from improper sources.
"Of course I bought it." Chen Shi'an grinned.
Su Qingrou said nervously, "Uncle, you don't want to steal people's things. If you are discovered, you will be kicked out of the city."
Chen Shi'an shook his head repeatedly, "Sister-in-law, don't worry, I bought this at the butcher shop.
It's the time when the stall is closing in the evening. Although the meat is not too fresh, the price is cheap. "
Su Qingrou blinked.Eyes, "Uncle, did you win money today?"
Chen Shi'an didn't want to explain more, so he just hummed.
Su Qingrou then said: "Brother-in-law, our family is short of money now, so we shouldn't waste it..."
Chen Shi'an waved his hand, "I've bought the meat. Let's cook quickly. Tiantian is so thin now. She's just growing up, so we can't let her suffer too much."
After saying that, he quickly left the kitchen and went back to continue practicing the art of drawing swords.
Su Qingrou looked at Chen Shi'an's back with complicated eyes.
I've known Chen Shi'an for so long, and this is the first time I've seen him care about others.
After a while, she murmured: "Did you hit a tree today and break your head?"
At this time, Chen Tiantian entered the kitchen, saw the meat on the cutting board, and immediately said happily: "Mom, have you gone to buy meat?"
Ever since her father was injured and bedridden, the family had saved all their money to go to the hospital and buy medicine. Chen Tiantian has barely seen any trace of meat in the past six months.
"Your uncle bought it." Su Qingrou stroked her daughter's head with a guilty look on her face.
Chen Tiantian's expression immediately changed, "Did he buy it? Mother, we have to be careful, be careful that he is a weasel paying New Year greetings to the chicken, and he has no good intentions."
Su Qingrou shook her head, "Tiantian, I don't want to talk about your brother-in-law like that. Haven't you noticed that he is obviously a little different today than before."
Chen Tiantian raised her eyes and looked in the direction of Chen Shi'an's house, and hummed: "My mother knows better than me what kind of temper he has. I bet that his fox tail will be exposed when we have dinner in the evening."
Su Qingrou did not refute again. Maybe her daughter was right.
……………
When the number of sword draws on the stone tablet reached 400, Chen Tiantian called for dinner through the window.
Chen Shi'an was hungry and tired, so he quickly put away his sword and hurried to the main room.
The meal was very simple. If he hadn't bought two kilograms of meat, there might have been only a plate of pickled radishes and an old pumpkin soup on the table.
The rice was cooked very thin, almost like porridge.
It's not that Su Qingrou's cooking skills are not good, but because she wants to save rice.
Chen Shi'an was already very hungry. As soon as it was served on the table, a few people finished the bowl of rice, continuing the style in the military camp.
However, when he went to serve the rice, he saw that the pot was completely clean, with not even a grain of rice left.
"Uncle, I'm really sorry. There's not enough rice cooked. Why don't you eat more vegetables?" Su Qingrou looked apologetic and quickly placed the plate with stir-fried pork in front of Chen Shi'an.
At the same time, she was also a little confused. Chen Shi'an had never had the habit of adding more rice, and sometimes he couldn't finish a bowl of rice.
This is why the original owner, a big man, couldn't hold back the delicate-looking Su Qingrou.
"It's okay, I'll just drink more soup." Chen Shi'an smiled slightly and served himself a full bowl of pumpkin soup.
"Idle all day, eating too much is a waste." Chen Tiantian snorted.
Su Qingrou's expression suddenly changed and she said hurriedly: "Uncle, please don't be angry. Tiantian is still young and can't speak."
After saying that, she stared at Chen Tiantian with an angry look on her face, "Girl, apologize to my uncle quickly!"
Seeing that her mother was really angry, Chen Tiantian realized that her words were a bit harsh. After a moment of hesitation, she was ready to apologize.
At this time, Chen Shi'an chuckled softly, "My uncle's body is already in shape and he won't grow any longer no matter how much he eats.
You are different. You are growing taller. Eat more meat and grow taller quickly. "
While talking, he brought the stir-fried pork in front of Chen Tiantian.
I picked up the pumpkin soup again and drank it all.
Then, he wiped his mouth and stood up, "Sister-in-law, I'm full, you eat slowly."
After saying that, he quickly walked out of the main room, returned to his room, and continued the great work of drawing the sword.
In the main room, Su Qingrou and Chen Tiantian looked at each other with complicated expressions.
Today, Chen TianTian ridiculed Chen Shian many times.
If Chen Shi'an had followed his past temperament, he would have retaliated long ago, and he might even take action.
But just now, facing Chen Tiantian's ridicule, Chen Shi'an was still smiling without any anger.
"Mom, what's wrong with my uncle? Has he really changed his gender?"
Chen Tiantian looked at the fried pork in front of her with surprise and confusion in her eyes, and then her face showed an extremely positive expression, "We must not be fooled by his tricks, he definitely has no good intentions.
He had money to buy meat, but he didn't pay back my New Year's money. He was still a shameless scoundrel.
I guessed that he wanted to drive us away, but if force didn't work, he planned to use conspiracy.
Yes! That must be it!
Mother, we must not trust him easily or be fooled by him. "
Su Qingrou looked at her daughter with a yellow and thin face, feeling both distressed and relieved.
To survive in the ruins, a little more caution and a sharp mind will give you an extra way to survive.
"Tiantian, whether Chen Shi'an has sincerely reformed or is just acting with us, you have to be more careful with what you say in the future, so as not to really annoy him.
If he really drives us out of the Chen family and we lose our status as residents of the walled city, our two mothers will have no way to survive immediately. " Su Qingrou reminded in a low voice.
Chen Tiantian frowned, "Why does he drive us out of the Chen family? He was picked up by his father and is not from our Chen family. If we want to drive him away, we should drive him away!"
Su Qingrou was shocked and quickly covered her daughter's mouth, "Girl, you are not allowed to say such things again. If others hear it, our whole family will be driven out of the city.
If there is no male in the family, the household registration in the walled city cannot be registered. Without your uncle, our Chen family would have to be cancelled. "
Chen Tiantian realized the seriousness of the problem and said quickly: "Mom, don't worry, I will never say anything like this outside in the future."
Su Qingrou's expression was serious, "Not only can't you say it outside, but you must also not let Chen Shi'an know!"
Chen Tiantian hummed and nodded heavily.
